  • The internal cervical os is closed. No focal uterine wall mass lesion noted in the accessible uterine segment. The region of the adnexa/parametria as well as the pelvic side walls are free of mass. The cul-de-sac is free of fluid.

Conclusion:

  • Viable Singleton Second Trimester Intrauterine Pregnancy with Normal Anatomic Scan
